## Reproduced retry-budget overrun
Tested PR #36 head `c6fa42c8db6e671a7166ea16672154ec97153e80`, exact `src/lock-retry.ts`, with the published SDK `2026.10.27`. Imports were redirected only to the isolated error helper and installed SDK; clock/sleep were virtualized. No real locks, processes, providers or tracker writes were exercised.

### Accepted contract
The current PM decision explicitly calls for bounded dead-owner retries with a configurable total budget (default 15s). This report concerns enforcement of that accepted decision, not the superseded proposal to prohibit package-side retries.

### Reproduction / actual
- Set `budgetMs=1`, deterministic jitter factor 1, and SDK lock_conflict context `reason: lock_owner_dead`, `recovery.retry_after_ms: 2000`.
- First operation at t=0 throws that typed refusal.
- Virtual sleep advances by 2000ms.
- Second operation begins at t=2000 and succeeds.
Result: `operationStartMs=[0,2000]`, `backoffMs=[2000]`, result `written`, despite the 1ms total retry budget.
Live-owner and zero-budget single-attempt controls passed.

The catch computes `remainingMs`, but does not cap its sleep to it, and the next loop invokes the operation without checking the deadline. Thus a fresh mutation can begin after the budget is exhausted. Existing in-flight SDK work need not be preempted to correct this.

### Expected / impact
Once the retry deadline expires, return the last typed lock-conflict rather than starting another mutation. Callers relying on a bounded recovery window can otherwise wait beyond it and initiate late writes.

### Acceptance / regression
- Cap backoff by remaining budget and recheck the deadline before every retry.
- Deterministic fake-clock regression: an excessive hint/sleep must not start a second operation after the deadline.
- Retain successful within-budget recovery, typed refusal preservation, and fast failure for live/unknown owners and non-lock errors.
- Clarify whether the budget includes the initial attempt and document that an already-running SDK operation is not preempted.

Sources: [PR #36](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-rlm/pull/36), [exact helper](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-rlm/blob/c6fa42c8db6e671a7166ea16672154ec97153e80/src/lock-retry.ts), [accepted PM decision](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-rlm/blob/c6fa42c8db6e671a7166ea16672154ec97153e80/.agents/pm/issues/pm-rlm-sdk-dead-fence.toon).
All-status issue/PR and current discussion/PM checks found no existing deadline-overrun issue; upstream pm-cli#1609 owns the underlying fence-recovery delay, not this wrapper budget bug.
Dead-owner retry can start a new mutation after its total retry budget expires
